footer: You can change any of these later in settings.
saveError: We couldn't save that. Check your connection and try again.

welcome.title: Welcome to GeneBridge
welcome.body: Hi, I'm here to help you understand your screening results. This takes about 2 minutes. After this first question, you can skip anything except the privacy step.
welcome.question: How will you use GeneBridge?

individual.label: For myself or my family
individual.sub: Understand a screening result, a family condition, or just learn

professional.label: I'm a health professional
professional.sub: Genetic counsellor or clinician. You'll need your facility code

facility.label: Facility code
facility.hint: Your facility gives you this code. It opens the counsellor workspace, not the patient app.
facility.invalid: That facility code didn't work. Check it and try again.
facility.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a while, then try again, or ask your facility.

language.title: Which language do you prefer?
language.body: You can change this at any time.
language.comingSoon: Full translation coming soon. For now, screens are shown in English.

learn.title: How do you like to learn?
learn.body: We'll set up every screen to match. Listening mode reads each card aloud.

reason.title: What brings you here?
reason.body: This helps us choose where to start.

premarital_result.label: My premarital screening result
premarital_result.sub: I have a result to understand

family_condition.label: A condition runs in my family
family_condition.sub: I want to understand my family's risk

privacy.title: Your privacy, in three points
privacy.body: Please read these, then agree to continue.

yours.title: Your result is yours
yours.body: Only you can see it at first.

privacy.required: Please tick the box to continue.

connect.title: Connect your screening result (optional)
connect.body: Enter the reference number from your screening centre, or scan the QR code on your report.
connect.label: Screening reference number
connect.scan: Scan the QR code on my report
connect.notFound: We couldn't find that reference. Check the number on your report, or ask your screening centre.
connect.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a while, then try again, or ask your screening centre.

scanner.label: Camera view for scanning the QR code
scanner.hint: Hold the QR code on your report inside the frame.
scanner.noCamera: We can't use the camera on this device.
scanner.found: Reference number found. Check it, then connect your result.

invite.title: Invite your partner (optional)
invite.body: They'll create their own private account.
invite.notice: Inviting your partner does not share your result. A couple view opens only when you both agree.
invite.copyManually: Copy this link to share it:
invite.linked: You're already connected with your partner.
invite.error: We couldn't create the invite. Please try again.
invite.message: I've joined GeneBridge to understand our screening results together. Join me here: {link}

body.results: Your next step is to see what your result means. Take your time.
body.counsellor: Your next step is to talk with a genetic counsellor, who will go through your result with you. Take your time.
body.home: Your home page is ready whenever you are. Take your time.

cta.counsellor: Talk to a counsellor about your result

invitePage.title: You've been invited to GeneBridge
invitePage.body: Your partner would like to connect your two accounts, so you can choose to look at your screening results together later.

points.private: Your account and your result stay private to you.
points.nothingShared: Accepting does not share any result, for either of you.
points.bothAgree: A couple view opens only if you both agree to it later.

invitePage.invalid: This invite link has expired or has already been used. Ask your partner to send a new one.
invitePage.own: This is your own invite link. Send it to your partner so they can join.
invitePage.alreadyLinked: One of you is already connected with a partner on GeneBridge.
invitePage.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
